Raclette (French Washed)

About This Entry

Raclette (French Washed) is a washed rind cow's milk cheese from FR (PDO).

Beginner Guide

Raclette (French Washed) is classified as washed rind cheese with cow milk source.

FAQ

What milk source is used in Raclette (French Washed)?
Raclette (French Washed) is made from cow's milk (Bos taurus).
